title: iOS iPhone Entra ID Shared Device Mode — Frontline SSO with Global Sign-In & Single Sign-Out (Teams & MSAL Apps)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (iOS + Entra Shared Device Mode + ABM/ADE no-affinity enrollment + apps; multi-component within one platform). Priced $2795 — above the single-user SSO extension sibling (IOSSSOEXT $2495) for the added no-affinity enrollment + shared-mode registration orchestration; below SHAREDIPAD ($2995).

Gap-only: distinct from IOSSDM (WebEx single-app kiosk, shared service account), IOSLD (lockdown profile), and SHAREDIPAD (Apple Managed Apple IDs, iPad-only). This is Entra ID Shared Device Mode = per-user global sign-in/single sign-out on shared iPhones.

Accuracy anchor: Apple Shared iPad is iPad-only, so Entra SDM is THE Microsoft-native shared-iPhone approach. iOS SDM app coverage narrower than Android; flagged 'verify per app', not invented.
White-label; Commercial-only per owner directive (no GCC High variant this run); Gov tier is price-only.
